name: Karbonn SWTV-20AE
summary: Karbonn SWTV-20AE ships with Skyworth ads, India-only preloads and telemetry. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and undo.
intro: This Karbonn set is built by Skyworth and ships with Skyworth content, ads and preloaded apps, plus a set of India-specific apps nobody asked for. It also carries telemetry and feedback services, an ambient screensaver and recommendation rows on the home screen.

The list was tested on the day it was applied and everything kept working. The set has only about 1.7 GB of memory, so a lighter home screen helps it feel less slow. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: The Skyworth Live TV and tuner input services
The Play Store and Google services
The Skyworth app store package, which the firmware will not let anyone switch off
notes: The Skyworth app store package is protected by the firmware, so it stays on.
Turning the animation speed down in Android settings can make this low-memory set feel quicker.

faq.q: Will it stop the ads on the home screen?
faq.a: Mostly. It turns off the Skyworth ads and content, the India-specific preloads and the recommendation rows on the stock home screen.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything turns every app back on and puts the old home screen back in one tap.

faq.q: Will Live TV and HDMI still work on my Karbonn SWTV-20AE?
faq.a: Yes. The Live TV and input services are kept, and testing on the day confirmed the set kept working.
